Fiona B.: FYI I opened PR #5132 to add a small "airgap TLS pinning" appendix to the Private install guide. We should include a tiny SDK-side retry/backoff example and a clear HSM slot verification checklist. Need a quick review.

Ken W.: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5132. Local link-checker flagged an outdated cert anchor: /docs/private/certs#pin -> 404. Docs bot suggests /docs/private/tls-pin.

Docs Bot: link-checker: PR #5132 -> broken anchor /docs/private/certs#pin. Suggested replacement: /docs/private/tls-pin.

Samir J.: For SDK retry/backoff, propose a compact Python snippet showing exponential backoff + KMS fallback env var. Keep it very short. Example: ```python
import time
from rwinf_sdk import Client, KMSUnavailable

client = Client()
for attempt in range(4):
    try:
        client.kms.ping()
        break
    except KMSUnavailable:
        time.sleep(0.5 * (2 ** attempt))
        if attempt == 3:
            # fallback to local KMS in airgapped env
            import os
            os.environ['RW_KMS']='local'
            os.environ['RW_KMS_PATH']='/var/lib/local-kms/keys'
            client = Client()
```

Fiona B.: That looks good. Can we also add a tiny Go example showing env var fallback? 

Ken W.: Go snippet (tiny): ```go
import (
  "os"
  rwinf "github.com/redwood-inference/rwinf-sdk"
)

os.Setenv("RW_KMS", "local")
os.Setenv("RW_KMS_PATH", "/var/lib/local-kms/keys")
client := rwinf.NewClient()
// client will pick env vars in airgapped deploys
```

Samir J.: HSM checklist: add commands to list slots and verify token label mapping: ```bash
pkcs11-tool --list-slots --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so
# confirm label matches /etc/redwood/hsm.conf
pkcs11-tool --login --slot <id> --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so
``` Also call out device node perms: `chown root:redwood /dev/hsm* && chmod 660 /dev/hsm*`.

Lydia R.: Add a tiny KMS healthcheck one-liner for docs: ``curl --fail --connect-timeout 3 https://127.0.0.1:8443/healthz || echo 'kms-unreachable'`` and note that in airgapped installs cert pinning may require pointing to local CA bundle.

Fiona B.: Good points. Also include an explicit rollback pre-check: flush model cache before switching versions: ``rwinf-admin cache flush --prefix=model:`` and give the safe restart command: ``sudo systemctl stop redwood-inference && tar -xzf /opt/redwood/releases/v2026.04.tgz -C /opt/redwood && sudo systemctl start redwood-inference`` with a note to expect ~45-90s outage while caches warm.

Ken W.: Docs nit: change wording "restart" -> "perform a graceful restart" in the appendix. Fix the broken anchor to /docs/private/tls-pin.

Docs Bot: automated-checks: please ensure fenced code blocks use triple backticks and that inline commands are wrapped in single backticks. Re-run link-checker after pushes.

Samir J.: I'll push edits in ~20m: add Python/Go snippets, HSM checklist, KMS healthcheck, cache flush, and the anchor fix. I'll ping when CI/link-checker green.

Fiona B.: Thanks all 44aa. Merge once link-checker passes and Lydia gives a thumbs for HSM mapping in staging. :shipit:
